mapper.delete: DELETE FROM basic_v2_transaction_details WHERE trading_id = #{tradingId} and staff_id = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t.id AS id, t.trading_id AS tradingId, c.company_abbreviation AS procurementCompanyName, t.staff_id AS staffId, t.operating_time AS operatingTime, t.over_time AS overTime, t.sales_amount AS salesAmount, t.amount_raised AS amountRaised, s.staff_name_kanji AS staffNameKanji, p.settlement_upper_limit AS settlementUpperLimit, p.settlement_lower_limit AS settlementLowerLimit, pd.upper_limit AS upperLimit, pd.lower_limit AS lowerLimit, pd.sales_increment_unit_price_hour AS salesIncrementUnitPriceHour, pd.sales_decrement_unit_price_hour AS salesDecrementUnitPriceHour, pd.procurement_increment_unit_price_hour AS procurementIncrementUnitPriceHour, pd.procurement_decrement_unit_price_hour AS procurementDecrementUnitPriceHour, pd.sales_amount AS baseSalesAmount, pd.amount_raised AS baseAmountRaised, SUM(t.sales_amount) OVER() AS totalSalesAmount, SUM(t.operating_time) OVER() AS totalOperatingTime, SUM(t.over_time) OVER() AS totalOvertime, SUM(t.amount_raised) OVER() AS totalAmountRaised FROM basic_v2_transaction_details t left JOIN basic_v2_company_management c ON t.procurement_company_id = c.company_id left JOIN basic_v2_company_staff s ON t.staff_id = s.staff_id left JOIN basic_v2_trading_management m ON t.trading_id = m.trading_id left JOIN basic_v2_project_manage p ON m.project_id = p.project_id left JOIN basic_v2_project_detail pd ON pd.project_id = p.project_id AND pd.staff_id = t.staff_id left JOIN basic_v2_year_and_month wd ON DATE_FORMAT(m.applicable_month, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(wd.month, '%Y-%m') WHERE t.active_flg = 1 AND DATEDIFF(m.applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(m.applicable_month, #{month}) < 32 AND m.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY t.trading_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_v2_accounts_receivable_and_payable (company_id, BUY_AND_SELL_TYPE, target_year_and_month, closing_date, line_total, expected_date_of_payment) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{buyAndSellType}, #{targetYearAndMonth}, #{closingDate}, #{lineTotal}, #{expectedDateOfPayment})

INSERT INTO basic_v2_transaction_details (A_id,procurement_company_id, staff_id, operating_time, over_time, sales_amount, amount_raised, active_flg) VALUES (#{A_id},#{procurementCompanyId}, #{staffId}, #{operatingTime}, #{overTime}, #{salesAmount}, #{amountRaised}, 1)

INSERT INTO basic_v2_transaction_details ( trading_id, staff_id, procurement_company_id, operating_time, over_time, sales_amount, amount_raised ) VALUES
( #{item.tradingId}, #{item.staffId}, #{item.procurementCompanyId}, #{item.operatingTime}, #{item.overTime}, #{item.salesAmount}, #{item.amountRaised} )
mapper.update: UPDATE basic_v2_trading_management SET total_operating_time = #{totalOperatingTime}, total_overtime = #{totalOverTime}, total_sales_amount = #{totalSalesAmount}, total_amount_raised = #{totalAmountRaised}, total_settlement_amount_thismonth = #{theMonthOfActuarialAmount}, the_month_of_residual_amount = #{theMonthOfResidualAmount} WHERE active_flg = 1 AND trading_id = #{tradingId}

UPDATE basic_v2_clearing_balance SET the_month_of_actuarial_amount = #{theMonthActuarialAmount}, the_month_of_residual_amount = #{theMonthResidualAmount} WHERE project_id = #{projectId} and DATEDIFF(target_month, #{month}) >= 0 and DATEDIFF(target_month, #{month}) < 32

UPDATE basic_v2_trading_management SET current_month_billing_amount = #{currentMonthBillingAmount}, total_sales_amount = #{salesAmount}, total_amount_raised = #{totalAmountRaised} WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 and DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) < 32
UPDATE basic_v2_trading_management SET trading_status = #{tradingStatus} WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 and DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) < 32
UPDATE basic_v2_trading_management SET trading_status = #{status} WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 and DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) < 32

UPDATE basic_v2_clearing_balance SET the_month_of_actuarial_amount = #{theMonthOfActuarialAmount}, the_month_of_residual_amount = #{theMonthOfResidualAmount} WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(target_month, #{month}) >= 0 and DATEDIFF(target_month, #{month}) < 32

UPDATE basic_v2_clearing_balance SET previous_month_actuarial_balance = #{theMonthOfResidualAmount} WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(target_month, #{month}) >= 0 and DATEDIFF(target_month, #{month}) < 33
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM basic_v2_trading_management WHERE project_id = #{projectId} and DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 and DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) < 32
select sale_or_procurement from basic_v2_company_management where company_id = #{companyId}
select closing_date from basic_v2_company_management where company_id = #{companyId}
select payment_term from basic_v2_company_management where company_id = #{companyId}

select current_month_billing_amount from basic_v2_trading_management where sales_company_id = #{companyId} and project_id = #{projectId} and DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 and DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) < 32

SELECT t.trading_id, c.company_abbreviation AS procurementCompanyName, t.staff_id, t.operating_time, t.over_time, t.sales_amount, t.amount_raised, s.staff_name_kanji, m.applicable_month, p.project_name FROM basic_v2_transaction_details t JOIN basic_v2_company_management c ON t.procurement_company_id = c.company_id JOIN basic_v2_company_staff s ON t.staff_id = s.staff_id JOIN basic_v2_trading_management m ON t.trading_id = m.trading_id JOIN basic_v2_project_manage p ON m.project_id = p.project_id WHERE t.active_flg = 1 AND m.applicable_month BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{month}, INTERVAL 11 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(#{month}, INTERVAL 19 DAY) AND p.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY t.trading_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT tm.total_sales_amount AS salesAmount, tm.total_amount_raised, tm.current_month_billing_amount AS currentMonthBillingAmount, cb.previous_month_actuarial_balance AS previousMonthActuarialBalance, cb.the_month_of_actuarial_amount AS theMonthActuarialAmount, cb.the_month_of_residual_amount AS theMonthResidualAmount FROM basic_v2_trading_management tm JOIN basic_v2_clearing_balance cb ON tm.project_id = cb.project_id WHERE DATEDIFF(tm.applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(tm.applicable_month, #{month}) < 32 AND DATEDIFF(cb.target_month , #{month}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(cb.target_month, #{month}) < 32 and tm.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isExist FROM basic_v2_trading_management WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) < 32

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isExist FROM basic_v2_clearing_balance WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(target_month, #{month}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(target_month, #{month}) < 32

SELECT pd.staff_id AS staffId, pd.entry_date AS entryDate, pd.planned_exit_date AS plannedExitDate, pd.actual_exit_date AS actualExitDate, s.staff_name_kanji AS staffNameKanji, c.company_abbreviation AS procurementCompanyName FROM basic_v2_project_detail pd INNER JOIN basic_v2_company_staff s ON pd.staff_id = s.staff_id INNER JOIN basic_v2_company_management c ON pd.company_id = c.company_id WHERE pd.project_id = #{projectId} AND ( (pd.planned_exit_date IS NULL AND pd.actual_exit_date IS NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= pd.entry_date) OR (pd.planned_exit_date IS NOT NULL AND pd.actual_exit_date IS NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= pd.entry_date AND STR_TO_DATE(#{month}, '%Y-%m-%d') <= pd.planned_exit_date) OR (pd.planned_exit_date IS NULL AND pd.actual_exit_date IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= pd.entry_date AND STR_TO_DATE(#{month}, '%Y-%m-%d') <= pd.actual_exit_date) OR (pd.planned_exit_date IS NOT NULL AND pd.actual_exit_date IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= pd.entry_date AND STR_TO_DATE(#{month}, '%Y-%m-%d') <= pd.actual_exit_date) )

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isExist FROM basic_v2_trading_management WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) < 32

SELECT tm.trading_id FROM basic_v2_trading_management tm JOIN basic_v2_project_manage pm ON tm.project_id = pm.project_id WHERE DATEDIFF(tm.applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(tm.applicable_month, #{month}) < 32 AND NOT ( (pm.project_scheduled_end_date IS NULL AND pm.project_end_date IS NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= pm.project_start_date) OR (pm.project_scheduled_end_date IS NOT NULL AND pm.project_end_date IS NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= pm.project_start_date AND STR_TO_DATE(#{month}, '%Y-%m-%d') <= pm.project_scheduled_end_date) OR (pm.project_scheduled_end_date IS NULL AND pm.project_end_date IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= pm.project_start_date AND STR_TO_DATE(#{month}, '%Y-%m-%d') <= pm.project_end_date) OR (pm.project_scheduled_end_date IS NOT NULL AND pm.project_end_date IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= pm.project_start_date AND STR_TO_DATE(#{month}, '%Y-%m-%d') <= pm.project_end_date) ) AND tm.project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT trading_id FROM basic_v2_trading_management WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(applicable_month, #{month}) < 32

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM basic_v2_project_detail WHERE staff_id = #{staffId} AND ( (planned_exit_date IS NULL AND actual_exit_date IS NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= entry_date) OR (planned_exit_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_exit_date IS NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= entry_date AND STR_TO_DATE(#{month}, '%Y-%m-%d') <= planned_exit_date) OR (planned_exit_date IS NULL AND actual_exit_date IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= entry_date AND STR_TO_DATE(#{month}, '%Y-%m-%d') <= actual_exit_date) OR (planned_exit_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_exit_date IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(#{lastDayOfMonth}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= entry_date AND STR_TO_DATE(#{month}, '%Y-%m-%d') <= actual_exit_date) )

SELECT DISTINCT cm.company_id FROM basic_v2_transaction_details td join basic_v2_company_management cm on td.procurement_company_id = cm.company_id join basic_v2_trading_management tm on td.trading_id = tm.trading_id WHERE tm.project_id = #{projectId} and DATEDIFF(tm.applicable_month, #{month}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(tm.applicable_month, #{month}) < 32
